text:
marta: Quick design sync: busy dashboard charts are clipping y-axis labels. Proposal: show compact units on axis ticks (k, M) + a contextual control (three-dot) that toggles "Full labels" per-widget. Keeps default density low.

zane: Agree. Add small info icon that reveals exact unit text and any aggregation window.

leo: A11y: that info must be keyboard-focusable and exposed with aria-describedby. Don’t hide full label with display:none for screen readers.

nora: Smoothing rule: enable a light 3-point moving average only for microcharts; on dashboard charts default off. Add a visible badge "Smoothed" when on.

aria: Outliers: suggestion to "soft-dim" values beyond 3 IQRs instead of rescaling axis. It keeps context. Also provide an alternate view "Focus on extremes" that opens a separate pane with re-scaled view.

marta: Tech note from zane: dimming is cheap (alpha + stroke) and maintains hover hits. Rescaling requires creating a separate y-scale layer and sync with legend.

zane: CSS snippet for compact axis pill:

```css
.axis-pill{padding:4px 6px;border-radius:6px;background:#f3f4f6;font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:420px){.axis-pill{display:inline-block}}
```

leo: UX test plan: 6 users, show two variants: (A) compact ticks + pill, (B) full labels truncated. Task: "Find the largest spike and read its value." Measure time + confidence.

marta: Decision: prototype variant A + dimming for outliers. Kai (not in thread) will mock mobile/desktop states. Will reconvene after prototype. :white_check_mark:
